title: 第5章 我要扇他狠狠扇他第6章 又没花你们的钱瞎操心什么
slug: 穿成女配弹幕让我又争又抢
content_zh:
【建材美妇王阿姨：gogogo，出发咯！】
季月忙扒开师弟们，几步跑到师尊跟前，细语中带着丝丝缕缕的委屈：
“师傅，我有话跟你说。”
藏在众弟子中的沈宴听到季月的话，紧张起来，哪怕季月发过毒誓，他还是不免担心她告诉师尊。
毕竟季月平时压根不修仙，整日和男人们勾勾搭搭好不快活，师尊溺爱，哪怕不思进取，这辈子都吃喝不愁。
所以那个誓言对季月的约束力无限接近于零。
祝徵何曾见过乖徒儿受委屈的模样，便从空间取出收集来的法宝和灵草，供弟子们自行分配。
随后，他领着季月进入尊主殿内。
季月直接表演一个美人啜泣，弱柳扶风般红了眼眶，一滴泪悬在眼睑欲落不落。
“师尊！”
声音中气很足。
看来没人苛待她饮食。
祝徵微微颔首，随即身形似雾气一散，眨眼间已落座于殿中主位之上。
尊主座由无尽海底的千年玄铁铸成，通体乌沉冰冷，上面镌刻着象征权力与地位的古老符文。
被祝徵那谪仙般出尘的男人坐着，竟奇异地调和了几分冷硬，让他显出不容亵渎的矜贵。
他慵懒地以一手单撑在脑侧，眼帘微垂，目光始终在殿中的季月身上，耐心的等待着她的下文。
【骂我是给：主播快上，只要不是杀人放火，祝徵很宠你的。】
季月见弹幕这么说，顿时信心满满的跑过去，一屁股坐到祝徵的身旁，“师尊，你看我与往常有什么不同？”
祝徵凤眼微眯，目光细细的扫过季月秾丽的眉眼、白皙的脸颊、漂亮的脖颈，再缓缓往下。
他的目光停到她的腹部，仿佛透过衣裙检查她的丹田。

里面空空如也。
“谁干的？”
季月内心惊叹他眼睛是x光吗？不着痕迹的坐远了些，“沈宴不让我说。”
她多聪明啊，她这话不算违背誓言。
祝徵阖上眼眸，神念微动，于识海中稍加搜寻，方记起沈宴此人，是他几年前所收的一个弟子。
他单手于虚空随意一划，空中泛起波纹形成一道晕染边缘的圆形光镜，镜中清晰地映出殿外景象。
沈宴正弓身缩颈，鬼鬼祟祟地贴向门扉，想要偷听。
祝徵手在镜前虚虚一握，光镜中，一只无形大手瞬间扼住沈宴的脖颈，紧接着他手腕轻轻地向后一扯——
光影流转，空间折叠。
沈宴便从殿外被生生摄至殿内，他狼狈的摔在地上，手捂住脖子，面色涨红，咳了好半晌才勉强顺过气来。
“月儿的灵根怎么回事？”祝徵问道。
沈宴强忍着害怕，将之前想好的说辞搬出来：“季师姐在岐山私自行动，遇到高阶猛兽，实力不敌，被挖了灵根，幸亏我及时赶到才救下一条命。”
祝徵转头看向季月，“是他说的这样吗？”
季月一昧的不语，泪水挂在了纤长的睫毛上，如晨间的露珠般晶莹剔透。
下一瞬，沈宴被强悍的灵力冲飞出去，直到撞到大殿尽头的门上发出“砰”的一声巨响，又摔到地上。
剧烈的疼楚让他求饶的话都还没说出，一口腥甜就抑制不住的从喉咙涌了上来。
“本尊再问一次，月儿的灵根去哪里了？”
殿上主位的男人明明一举一动仙风玉骨，语气却森冷如地狱锁魂的阎王。
content_en:
[Auntie Wang, the beautiful building materials woman: gogogo, let’s go! 】
Ji Yue hurriedly pushed aside the junior brothers and ran to the master in a few steps, whispering with traces of grievance:
"Master, I have something to tell you."
Shen Yan, who was hiding among the disciples, became nervous when he heard Ji Yue's words. Even though Ji Yue had sworn a poisonous oath, he still couldn't help but worry about her telling the master.
After all, Ji Yue doesn't practice immortality at all. She spends her days hooking up with men and having fun. Her master dotes on her, and even if she doesn't want to make progress, she will have nothing to worry about in her life.
So the binding force of that oath on Ji Yue is infinitely close to zero.
Zhu Zhenghe had never seen his good disciple being wronged, so he took out the collected magic weapons and spiritual herbs from the space for the disciples to distribute among themselves.
Then, he led Ji Yue into the Lord's Hall.
Ji Yue directly acted like a beautiful woman sobbing, her eyes were as red as a weak willow supporting the wind, and a drop of tear hung on her eyelid, unwilling to fall.
"Master!"
The voice is full of breath.
It seems that no one treats her diet harshly.
Zhu Zheng nodded slightly, and then his figure seemed to dissipate like mist, and in the blink of an eye he was sitting on the main seat in the palace.
The Lord's Seat is made of thousand-year-old dark iron from the endless seabed. It is dark and cold, with ancient runes symbolizing power and status engraved on it.
The man Zhu Zheng, who had been relegated to immortality, was sitting there, but he was strangely tempered with a bit of coldness, making him look dignified and dignified that could not be blasphemed.
He lazily placed one hand on the side of his head, his eyes slightly lowered, always looking at Ji Yue in the palace, patiently waiting for her next words.
[You are scolding me for this: Anchor, come on, as long as you are not killing people and setting fires, Zhu Zheng will love you very much. 】
Seeing what the barrage said, Ji Yue immediately ran over with confidence and sat down next to Zhu Zheng, "Master, do you think I am different from usual?"
Zhu Zhengfeng narrowed his eyes slightly and scanned Ji Yue's beautiful eyebrows, fair cheeks, and beautiful neck carefully, and then slowly went down.
His gaze stopped at her abdomen, as if examining her pubic area through her dress.
It was empty inside.
"Who did it?"
Ji Yue wondered inwardly: Are his eyes X-rays? He sat further away without leaving a trace, "Shen Yan didn't let me say anything."
How smart she is, what she said is not a violation of her oath.
Zhu Zheng closed his eyes, his mind moved slightly, and after searching in the sea of ​​consciousness, he remembered that Shen Yan was a disciple he had accepted a few years ago.
He made a random stroke in the void with one hand, and ripples appeared in the air, forming a circular light mirror with a haloed edge. The scene outside the hall was clearly reflected in the mirror.
Shen Yan was hunching his head and leaning towards the door furtively, trying to eavesdrop.
Zhu Zheng held his hand in front of the mirror. In the mirror, an invisible big hand instantly strangled Shen Yan's neck, and then gently pulled his wrist back——
Light and shadow flow, space folds.
Shen Yan was taken from outside the palace to the palace. He fell to the ground in a state of embarrassment, covering his neck with his hands, his face turned red, and he coughed for a long time before he managed to regain his breath.
"What happened to Yue'er's spiritual roots?" Zhu Zheng asked.
Shen Yan suppressed his fear and said what he had thought up before: "Senior Sister Ji was acting privately in Qishan Mountain. She encountered a high-level beast and was outmatched. Her spiritual roots were dug out. Fortunately, I arrived in time and saved a life."
Zhu Zheng turned to look at Ji Yue, "Is that what he said?"
Ji Yue remained silent, tears hanging on her long eyelashes, as crystal clear as morning dewdrops.
The next moment, Shen Yan was rushed out by the powerful spiritual power until he hit the door at the end of the hall with a loud "bang" and fell to the ground again.
The severe pain prevented him from saying anything to beg for mercy, but a mouthful of fishy sweetness surged up from his throat uncontrollably.
"I would like to ask again, where did Yue'er's spiritual roots go?"
The man at the head of the palace clearly acted like an immortal in every move, but his tone was as cold as the King of Hell locked in a soul.
